description: Tuples that differ after an unknown element compare as an unknown bool
notes: The spec says tuples are equal only if all corresponding elements are equal; the second elements differ, so the result should be false whatever the unknown is. hashicorp/hcl compares elements in order and stops at the first unknown one (Value.Equals in cty/value_ops.go), so it returns an unknown bool, while a difference before the unknown gives false (equal-tuples-differing-before-unknown).
